description:
## What's new

- **Centered share pictures.** The title and artist on the story card are now properly centered instead of sitting on the left.
- **Links open the app like Spotify.** Shared links now show the familiar "Open with Lunara" chooser and jump straight into the app when it is installed, falling back to the website only when it is not.
- **Cleaner changelog.** The changelog now shows only recent releases instead of the entire history.
- **Fresh permanent signing key.** A brand-new release signing key, so the app installs cleanly and future updates install over it without a signature mismatch.
